CheckTitle: Network Security Group is not empty
Description: Verify that NSGs contain rules to filter network traffic.
Risk: Empty NSGs do not provide any network security boundary.

Code.CLI: az network nsg rule create -g <resource-group> --nsg-name <nsg-name> -n <rule-name> --priority 100 --access Deny --direction Inbound --protocol '*' --source-address-prefixes '*' --source-port-ranges '*' --destination-address-prefixes '*' --destination-port-ranges '*'

Recommendation.Text: Review and implement the recommended configuration for Network Security Group Not Empty.
